title: Republic of Botswana
capsule: Botswana is a landlocked republic in southern Africa that became independent from British rule on 30 September 1966, succeeding the Bechuanaland Protectorate. Its economy was among the world's poorest at independence but was transformed by diamond production after the discovery and development of major kimberlite pipes at Orapa (1967) and Jwaneng (1982), and the country sustained one of the highest GDP growth rates globally through the 1970s–1990s under successive administrations of the Botswana Democratic Party. The government has been consistently rated among the least corrupt in Africa and maintained uninterrupted multiparty elections. The Kalahari Desert covers roughly 70 percent of the territory, and the Okavango Delta in the northwest constitutes one of the world's largest inland deltas.
